info.name: Marketplace - Customer API
info.description:
Customer-facing API collection.

Base path: `/api/customer/v1/{country}/...`

Auth: JWT Bearer token via guard `customer`. Obtain via Auth > Login or Register, then set `access_token` collection variable (auto-set by the test scripts on Login/Register/Refresh).

Standard success envelope: `{ "success": true, "message": "...", "data": {...} }`
Standard error envelope: `{ "success": false, "message": "...", "errors": {...} }`
Validation errors (422) use Laravel's default shape: `{ "message": "...", "errors": { "field": ["msg"] } }`

variable.description: Root domain of the API (no trailing slash).
Country/site code path segment resolved by the `detect.country` middleware (e.g. sa, ae, eg).
JWT access token for guard `customer`. Set automatically after Login/Register/Refresh.
JWT refresh token. Set automatically after Login/Register/Refresh.

request.description:
Registers a new customer account.

Body params:
- `name` (string, required, max:255) — full name.
- `email` (string, required, email, max:255, unique) — must be unique across customers.
- `phone` (string, nullable, max:20, unique) — E.164-ish phone, must be unique if provided.
- `password` (string, required, min:8, confirmed) — must be paired with `password_confirmation`.
- `password_confirmation` (string, required if password set) — must match `password`.
- `referral_code` (string, nullable, size:8) — optional referrer's 8-char code.
